newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Otter plans one for 5 bonus option issue.
newsitem.headline: Otter plans one for 5 bonus option issue.

text.p: Otter Gold Mines Ltd said on Tuesday its board was recommending a one for five bonus option issue, pro rata to all shareholders.
Subject to approval at the October 31 annual meeting, shareholders will be entitled to one free non-renounceable share option for every five shares.
The bonus shares will have a term of nearly five years, to October 31, 2001, and are first exercisable on June 30, 1998 at NZ$2.75 per option.

The board said it believed the issue of bonus options would improve the market in its ordinary shares and ensure it was best placed for future funding, particularly to capitalise on opportunities flowing from its current successes in the Tanami region in Australia.
